info.title: OGC API - Maps
info.description: Example API Definition for OGC API - Maps - Part 1: Core

get.summary: Retrieve a map for the specified collection
Retrieve a map for a specified collection and style

transparent-map.name: transparent
transparent-map.description: Whether the map background is transparent. Values true and false are case-insensitive; repeated parameters use the first value. Defaults to true. PNG supports transparency; JPEG does not.

bbox.name: bbox
bbox.description: Only resources that have a geometry that intersects the bounding box are selected. The bounding box is provided as four numbers: lower left corner, coordinate axis 1; lower left corner, coordinate axis 2; upper right corner, coordinate axis 1; and upper right corner, coordinate axis 2. The coordinate reference system is WGS84 longitude/latitude (http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/OGC/1.3/CRS84) unless bbox-crs specifies another CRS. For WGS84 longitude/latitude, values are normally minimum longitude, minimum latitude, maximum longitude and maximum latitude. If the box spans the antimeridian, the west-most edge may be larger than the east-most edge.

crs-map.name: crs
crs-map.description: Coordinate reference system of the map response. If omitted, the configured default map CRS is used.

bbox-crs-map.name: bbox-crs
bbox-crs-map.description: Coordinate reference system of the bbox. If omitted, WGS 84 longitude/latitude is assumed. The configured default map CRS is the only explicitly supported value.

width.name: width
width.description: Width of the map in pixels. If omitted and `height` is specified, defaults to the width maintaining a 1:1 aspect ratio. If both `width` and `height` are omitted, the server will select default dimensions.

height.name: height
height.description: Height of the map in pixels. If omitted and `width` is specified, defaults to the height maintaining a 1:1 aspect ratio. If both `width` and `height` are omitted, the server will select default dimensions.

f-map.name: f
f-map.description: The format of the map response (e.g. png). Accepted values are 'png', 'jpeg' or 'html'.

styleId-collection.name: styleId
styleId-collection.description: An identifier representing a specific style.

Map.description: A map image returned as a response.

Content-Crs.description: CRS used to render the map.

Content-Bbox.description: Bounding box of the map in the response CRS.
